observations.known_harness_issue: notepad/calc probes used empty ArgumentList; fixed in run-guest-registry-value-experiment.py after this pilot

observations.post_attempt_state: guest still did not return to QGA and remained stuck after Windows Boot Manager
observations.reverted_with: SystemRescue offline BCD hive edit restored recoveryenabled=1 and bootstatuspolicy=0

details: Mounted Windows NTFS volume after ntfsfix -d.
Verified PerfCalculateActualUtilization was already restored to 1.
Restored BCD recovery flags from the EFI BCD store.
chkdsk C: /f corrected corrupt NTFS metadata and reported no further filesystem action required.
offline sfc reported no integrity violations.
dism /Image:C:\ /Cleanup-Image /RevertPendingActions completed once, but reboot still returned to Startup Repair.
later DISM retry with /ScratchDir:C:\Temp failed with 0x800f082f.
safe mode also returned to Startup Repair; safeboot, sos, and bootlog flags were removed.

observations.note: VM left shut off to preserve failed state and avoid further mutation.

verdict.causality_note: The lane proves an observed regression after setting the value to 0 and rebooting. It does not prove the value is the only possible cause because filesystem corruption and pending-action symptoms were also observed during recovery.
verdict.recommendation: treat non-default values as advanced opt-in, reboot-risky, and VM-profile-sensitive until a disposable-overlay replay proves a safe envelope
verdict.future_gate: require libvirt domain snapshot or disposable overlay before future boot-critical value experiments
